history.text: Welcoming Dr Antoine Barbot and Valentin from FEMTO-ST, CNRS, for research discussions and shared activities during their April 2026 visit.
Our group photo records the growth and efforts of every member at Imperial College London.

description: Research grows through shared experiments, discussion and collaboration. The MSEI gallery brings together current lab life and the earlier Biorobotics, student project and research event archive.
